answer.reason: The verses tell how the breastpiece was worn on Aaron's heart with the names of Israel and held the Urim and Thummim.

clauses.english: bore the names of the children of Israel on Aaron's heart as a memorial before the LORD
clauses.quote: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart

clauses.english: held the Urim and the Thummim, which Aaron wore on his heart before the LORD
clauses.quote: thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim

doubts: EXO 36:15-16 and 36:22-28 are marked but speak of tabernacle curtains and boards, not the breastpiece, so they were left out.
The making of the breastpiece (EXO 39:8-21) was left out as construction detail, to keep the line short.
